players.product: Xiyun C500/C600 training-inference GPGPU boards and modules (plus Xisi N inference GPUs), GPU servers and supernode/cluster solutions with the MXMACA software stack

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Chen Weiliang (2025 annual results briefing): with the AI chip market growing fast and domestic substitution accelerating, he expects revenue growth to stay high, gross margin and expense ratios to stabilise, and the company could reach breakeven as early as 2026 - hedged: results may fall short and this is not a profit forecast.

Chairman Chen Weiliang (2025 annual results briefing): the Xiyun C700, a next-generation general-purpose GPU on a more advanced domestic process with a new GPU architecture and instruction set and added FP4 support, was set up as a project in April 2025; most core design and functional verification is done and deeper performance tuning is under way; positioned as the flagship of the domestic supply chain, it should extend from the C600's xinchuang market into internet customers. On January 27, 2026 MetaX launched the Xisuo X GPU line optimised for scientific-intelligence (AI for science) computing.
